subject: Day 80: bookend the day with a book
bodyText:
Today's focus
End of the first quarter, and for families on standard 12-week leave this is return-to-work week. The operational goal is continuity: a fixed reading ritual at the start and end of the day keeps Avi anchored through caregiver handoffs.

Action items
- Read the same board book at morning drop-off and evening pick-up. Bookending the day with one fixed text gives Avi a predictable signal on either side of childcare and turns the handoff into a routine rather than a rupture. AAP early literacy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/early-childhood/early-literacy/
- Pack the daycare or nanny bag the night before: labeled bottles, two spare outfits, a day of diapers, and a sleep sack. Confirm the communication channel so you get same-day feeding and nap notes.
- Get the pumping rhythm operational at about three sessions per 8-hour workday, 15-20 minutes each. Refrigerate immediately and freeze the same day if milk will not be used within four days.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Mild adjustment fussiness in the first one to two weeks of a new childcare arrangement is expected and usually settles as the routine stabilizes.
- [monitor] Crying that is out of proportion to the handoff context, or night wakings that start creeping up. Note the date the pattern changes so you can tell regression from adjustment.
- [call within 24h] A first childcare fever of 100.4F rectal or higher. Under 90 days this still needs same-day evaluation regardless of how minor it looks.
- [call now] Apnea, a color change during sleep, or blue lips. Call 911 and do not wait to see if it passes.

Enrichment opportunities
- Read aloud about 15-20 minutes a day, rotating three to five favorites with one fresh title. At this age the prosody and repetition do the work; the same book read at both ends of the day compounds the exposure. AAP early literacy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/early-childhood/early-literacy/
- Stagger 75-90 minutes of tummy time across short bouts, placing toys at varying distances to motivate pivoting and reaching as he pushes up on extended arms. AAP Back to Sleep, Tummy to Play: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
- Keep the dim-lights-after-sunset wind-down identical every evening. A stable pre-sleep sequence becomes the sleep-onset cue you will lean on when the 4-month regression arrives. AAP getting your baby to sleep: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Getting-Your-Baby-to-Sleep.aspx

Upcoming
- Day 84-91 (~3 months): sleep-consolidation window opens; lock in a consistent sleep-wake routine before the 4-month sleep architecture shift.
- Day 112-126 (~4 months): 4-month well visit with RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.
- Day 98-126 (~14-18 weeks): 4-month sleep regression typically begins as night sleep fragments.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Looks at you, moves, or makes sounds to keep your attention
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Active engagement — baby is now driving the interaction, not just responding.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/moves-to-get-attention/complete

- Pushes up on elbows during tummy time
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Tripod position. Builds toward eventual rolling.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/pushes-up-on-elbows/complete

- Holds a toy when you put it in his hand
  AAP window: day 70-120
  What to look for: Voluntary grasp emerging. Soon followed by reaching.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/holds-toy-when-placed/complete

- Smiles on his own to get your attention
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Initiates the smile rather than responding to yours — emerging social agency.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/smiles-to-get-attention/complete

- Chuckles (not yet a full laugh)
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Throaty soft laugh sounds. Precedes the full belly laugh by a few weeks.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/chuckles/complete
